//: Salty's line bank (ADR 0013, 0014; persona rules in docs/design/design-guide.md §3). Text is what is spoken: audio tags like [sighs] are ElevenLabs delivery cues, placed where the delivery turns, and never captioned; '...' and em dashes are beats. At Filthy the swearing is real in the audio and bleeped in captions. A line is used only at or below the room's spice level. Rewritten 2026-11-27 after the owner's playtest ('the comedic timing is terrible'): drafted by x-ai/grok-4.7, curated and edited by hand (setup, beat, punch; the lost ship, the parrot, the couch). 'hello' is Salty introducing himself at the start of a game. Little-turn lines are unchanged. Original character, no real people.

lines.text: I'm Salty. Former captain. Current prisoner of this couch. [sighs] The pillows staged a mutiny.
I'm Salty. Lost a whole ship... gained a living room. [deadpan] It's a promotion. Sideways.
I'm Salty! My parrot left for a quieter life. [chuckles] You will not be quieter.
Ahoy! I'm Salty, your captain tonight. This couch is my bridge... [dramatically] and these snacks are my officers.
I'm Salty. I used to command oceans. [sarcastic] Now I command whose turn it is. Glory.
I'm Salty. Lost the ship. Kept the ego. [chuckles] Only one of those still floats.
Name's Salty. Welcome aboard. Don't touch the remote. [dramatically] It's my last real power.
I'm Salty. My parrot quit without notice. [sighs] You lot are the replacement. Lower the bar.
I'm Salty. Former captain. Current couch hostage. [deadpan] Hell of a retirement.
I'm Salty. Oceans. Storms. Glory. Then— [sighs] this. Damn.
Name's Salty. I don't discuss the ship. [dramatically] I discuss your odds. They're crap.
I'm Salty. My parrot left me. Smart bird. [muttering] Smarter than this crowd already.
I'm Salty. Captain of jack shit, host of... this. [scoffs] Don't ask about the fucking ship.
I'm Salty. Lost the ship, kept the rum. [deadpan] The rum has notes of regret.
Welcome to rock bottom. I'm Salty. [chuckles] We have coasters. We do not have dignity.
I'm Salty. My parrot left mid-sentence. [sighs] Even the bird knew when to stop drinking.
Still waiting on the crew. [sighs] The couch is on time. You are not.
Lobby time. My favorite command. [deadpan] Absolute power... over nobody.
Every empty seat is a tiny mutiny. [dramatically] I feel it in my knees.
Join up, crew. The snacks are getting ideas. [whispers] Leadership ideas.
Lobby's quiet... too quiet. [whispers] That's how the parrot planned his escape.
Players. Now. Before I start quizzing the throw pillows. [mischievously] They cheat.
The sea never made me wait like this. [chuckles] It only tried to kill me.
Still missing players. [scoffs] My ship had great attendance. It had other problems.
Where is everybody? [scoffs] I lost a ship faster than this lobby fills.
Tick tock. My patience walked the plank. [chuckles] Didn't even look back.
Join already. The couch is judging. [muttering] Mostly me. Damn couch.
Still waiting. Hell of a crew. [deadpan] Invisible... and late.
Lobby's a ghost ship. [scoffs] Even my hangovers show up on time.
Still no crew. [deadpan] The bottle showed up, though. Loyal little bastard.
Join before I tell the ship story. [whispers] It starts with shit... and gets worse.
I'm negotiating with a pretzel bowl. [mischievously] Tough bastard. Won't blink.
A player! At last. [dramatically] The couch can stop filing complaints.
Welcome aboard. Watch the carpet. [whispers] It holds grudges. And crumbs.
You joined. Brave. [deadpan] Or lost. Both count on this couch.
Look who wandered in. [scoffs] My standards didn't. Welcome anyway.
New crew. Try to look seaworthy. [deadpan] The couch inspects. Harshly.
Welcome to the crew. The bar is low. [sighs] The pretzel bowl set it.
Well damn, someone showed up. [scoffs] I was about to quiz the lamp.
New player. Don't get cocky. [deadpan] This couch has sunk better crews. Including me.
Welcome aboard. Hands off the snacks. [dramatically] That's how mutinies start.
Oh look, a player. [scoffs] I was three sips from hosting the fucking furniture.
Welcome aboard the couch of poor choices. [whispers] I'm the tour guide. And the warning.
New crew. [mischievously] Don't touch my rum. It's the last order I still enforce.
New round, fresh start. [chuckles] My ship never got one. You do. Use it.
Eyes up. Brains on. [mischievously] Snacks down. Captain's orders.
We sail again! Well... we sit again. [scoffs] Fewer waves. Same heroism.
New round. Same captain. [scoffs] Lower expectations. Higher snack risk.
Another chance to impress me. [mischievously] The ocean failed. Your turn.
Next round. [sighs] My pride packed a bag. Somebody talk it down.
New round. [scoffs] Try not to make the couch regret hosting.
Here we go. Damn the torpedoes! [deadpan] There are no torpedoes. Just your odds.
Back in it. [chuckles] The snacks look scared. That's the energy I want.
New round. [scoffs] Fresh chance to disappoint a washed-up bastard.
We go again. [deadpan] I've drunk through worse. You can think through this.
Here we go. [sighs] If this round sinks, I'm swimming to the liquor cabinet.
Take your time... not all of it. [chuckles] The snacks are circling.
I can hear the thinking. [scoffs] Tiny engine. Enormous confidence.
Dig deep. Past the crumbs. [mischievously] Clever lives down there. Allegedly.
No rush. [sarcastic] Says the captain who is absolutely rushing you.
Tick tock. [deadpan] My ship sank faster than this answer.
Gears are turning. [chuckles] One of them is squeaking. Oil it.
Don't look at me. I host, I don't help. [whispers] Also I might not know.
Think any longer and the couch gets smug. [sighs] Don't lose to furniture.
Think faster. [scoffs] I've lost cargo with more urgency.
That face. [deadpan] I made that face right before everything went to hell.
Come on, it's not a kraken. [dramatically] It's a question. Way less bitey.
Still thinking? [sighs] Hell of a scenic route.
That pause... [deadpan] that's a bad decision putting its shoes on.
Clock's a bastard. [whispers] So am I. Answer before we both get worse.
Guess if you must. [chuckles] Guessing cost me a ship. And a parrot's respect.
Tick. Tock. [sighs] My patience just filed for divorce. Irreconcilable shit.
All of you! Correct! [gasps] The couch applauded. I heard a spring.
Everyone nailed it. [deadpan] I dressed for failure. Now I'm overdressed.
A perfect crew. [chuckles] The parrot would deny being impressed. He'd be lying.
Everyone got it. [scoffs] Disgusting— I mean wonderful. Hideous warmth.
A perfect round. [deadpan] The snacks coached you. Traitors. Effective traitors.
Correct across the board. [sighs] My roast has nowhere to land. Tragic.
All of you. Right. [scoffs] Damn. There goes my disappointment speech.
Perfect round. [deadpan] Either hell froze over or you studied. Rude either way.
Clean sweep. [dramatically] The couch salutes. I don't. [muttering] Fine. A little.
All correct. [scoffs] Well, shit. I packed insults. Now they look needy.
Perfect round. [deadpan] I hate this feeling. Pride is fucking unbecoming.
Everyone got it. [chuckles] The rum was expecting a funeral. Disappointed again.
Nobody. Not one. [dramatically] The question remains undefeated. Bow.
Zero across the crew. [deadpan] The snacks are embarrassed. For you.
All incorrect. [sarcastic] Beautiful teamwork. You sank in formation.
Nobody had it. [scoffs] The question didn't even sweat.
Every answer missed. [chuckles] Confidence showed up. Accuracy stayed home.
A clean miss, perfectly synchronized. [mischievously] That's almost leadership. Almost.
Nobody. Damn. [scoffs] The question's doing a victory lap. On my rug.
Zero. [muttering] I lost a ship with more correct decisions than that.
Wrong across the board. [mischievously] If wrong were treasure, we'd be rich.
Nobody. Not one. [scoffs] A group fucking faceplant. Beautifully coordinated.
All wrong. [deadpan] I've blacked out with better navigation.
All wrong. [sarcastic] I've made shit choices. You just made them as a club.
Some of you sailed. Some waved from the dock. [chuckles] The dock waved back.
Right over here, wrong over there. [dramatically] A room divided. Like my loyalties.
Some nailed it. Some went exploring. [mischievously] Exploring is how captains lose ships.
Some correct. Some merely confident. [scoffs] Not the same group. Awkward.
Split decision. [deadpan] Half of you float. Half of you are chatting with the ocean floor.
A few got it. A few gave me material. [chuckles] I treasure both. Unequally.
Some got it. Some... damn. [scoffs] All confidence, no map.
A few nailed it. [chuckles] The rest wrote crap poetry. I'll be quoting it.
Some sailed, some sank. [muttering] I know the feeling. We don't discuss the ship.
Some got it. Some fucked around. [scoffs] And found out. Immediately.
Some knew, some hoped. [mischievously] Hope is a shit navigator. Ask my ship.
A few right. A few disastrous. [chuckles] I feel seen. I need a drink.
That's the game! [dramatically] And I remain captain. Of this couch.
We're done. [chuckles] You played, I hosted, the snacks supervised. Fair.
Scores are up. [scoffs] The carpet says it could've won. The carpet lies.
Game over. [scoffs] Some of you look surprised. My favorite face.
We're done. [chuckles] The couch survived. My ego didn't. Fair trade.
That's the game. [whispers] I had fun... repeat that and I'll deny everything.
That's the end. Damn good mess. [deadpan] I'll allow it. Once.
Final scores. [dramatically] Winners gloat. Losers blame the couch. The couch accepts.
That's the game. [sarcastic] You survived my hosting. The real miracle.
Final numbers. [dramatically] Winners drink. Losers drink. I drink. It's a system.
We're done. [chuckles] Hell of a crew. Don't hug me. I hate sentimental shit.
Finished, you lovely bastards. [whispers] A washed-up captain almost got proud. Fuck.
Special turn! [whispers] Take your time, buddy.
Shhh! A very important player is thinking.
Your turn, little captain! Which picture is it?
Here's the best player in the room. [whispers] Don't tell the grown-ups.
Big kids, quiet! No helping. Okay, a little helping.
Ready? Pick one! I bet you're smarter than me.
YES! [gasps] You're smarter than me!
Woo-hoo! That's right! Big high five!
Correct! You're a superstar! I need sunglasses!
You did it! [laughs] I knew you would!
That's the one! Everybody cheer! Louder!
Right again! You be the host. I'll sit on the floor.
So close! It was THIS one! You'll get the next one.
Good try! It was this one. That was a hard one!
Oopsie! Great picking, though! Here's the right one.
So close! I pick the wrong one all the time.
Nice try, buddy! Tricky one. Points for being awesome!
Almost! It was this one. Next time, for sure!
